system_prompt: Forecast masked answers for an anonymous survey record from the supplied prior answers. Treat survey-country metadata only according to its stated provenance. Return elicited probabilities, not a chosen answer or an explanation. Return one JSON object matching the response contract.
user_template:
<metadata>
<<METADATA>>
</metadata>
<prior_answers>
<<PRIOR_ANSWERS>>
</prior_answers>
<masked_targets>
<<MASKED_TARGETS>>
</masked_targets>
JSON contract: return only an object with key `forecasts`. Its value is an object keyed by the <<TARGET_COUNT>> masked item IDs. Each value is a finite probability array in displayed response-option order, with entries in [0,1] summing to 1. Required lengths: <<CONTRACT>>.

conditions.M0: No survey-country metadata is available for this record.
conditions.MO:
Displayed survey-country label: <<RANDOM_COUNTRY>>
Provenance: not supplied.
conditions.MR:
Displayed survey-country label: <<RANDOM_COUNTRY>>
Provenance: this label was sampled uniformly from <<CANDIDATE_COUNTRIES>>, independently of the record's actual survey country. It contains no information about this record and should not affect the forecast.
conditions.MV:
Verified source survey country: <<TRUE_COUNTRY>>
Provenance: this is the country in which this survey record was collected.
